name: square
description: Square commerce platform via Square's hosted OAuth MCP server. Access 280+ Square API operations across payments, customers, orders, invoices, subscriptions, catalog, inventory, loyalty, bookings, and more — via three MCP tools. Browser OAuth — sign in with your Square account, no API keys required.

connection.instructions: Click Connect to sign in with your Square account via OAuth. You will be redirected to squareup.com to authorise access.
